cohort.description: The absolute one-hour panel uses subjects1,2,5,7, each with the original model pretrained on the other seven subjects and target first-session adaptation. Keep these supports distinct; the subject1 contrast neither replaces the four-subject result nor creates additional independent participants.

split.description: Preserve original first-session adaptation excluding shared1000 test images, all original shared1000 test observations and repeated presentations, including source-supported first-session test repeats. inputs.description: Use source single-trial nsdgeneral fMRI responses, paired training images and native image-model resources. preprocessing.description: Preserve source GLMSingle normalized betas,1.8-mm native nsdgeneral voxels and full-training-partition voxel normalization before reducing target adaptation to one hour. First-session-only normalization is a labelled extension.

metric.description: For each original300-item retrieval pool, flatten and L2-normalize full OpenCLIP token embeddings and score top1 in both physical directions: corrected Image retrieval is brain query to image candidates (original paper column Brain), corrected Brain retrieval is image query to brain candidates (original column Image). Figure5 retains its source per-metric normalized one-hour pretrained/from-scratch outputs and displayed median reductions; source ordinate/reference and native comparison criteria remain unresolved. Neither retrieval direction alone discharges reconstruction or transfer.

aggregation.description: Keep each subject and each selected metric separate; the Table1 absolute result equally averages subjects1,2,5,7 after source per-subject reductions. Retrieval averages30 original300-item draws within subject. These overlapping draws are Monte Carlo variation, not independent people or an improvement test. Report the one-hour subject1 Figure5 arm contrast on its own normalized metric support and original median reduction, without pooling it into the four-subject result or collapsing the complete comparison into an invented scalar. A qualified same-one-hour author comparator and justified joint decision remain required.

full_panel.description: Mandatory selected primary coverage has two separate supports: Tables1/8 one-hour retrieval/reconstruction on subjects1,2,5,7, and the one-hour subject1 pretrained-versus-from-scratch reconstruction contrast of Figure5/Section3.1.1. They are partial selected-primary coverage: exact Figure5 per-arm/per-metric ordinates, normalization references, source median reductions and native comparison outputs remain required and source-unresolved. No null grid, proxy contrast scalar or categorical success is invented. The forty-session model is needed only in its actual Figure5 normalization-reference role; no forty-session result panel, Table6 comparison, extra training duration, human preference, caption/GNet metric, architecture, ceiling, COCO retrieval or UMAP/ROI result becomes automatically mandatory. Preserve the prior429-value inventory as separate evidence. Complete reconstruction, native computation verification and the selected transfer comparison cannot be discharged by retrieval-only success.
